values: 一名威严可靠的坦克，能够召唤法阵进行战斗。
A tough and reliable Tank who can summon ritual zones.
Turn back now—this is your final warning.
This is as far as you go.
你以为的选择，并不存在。
The choice you thought you had... never existed.
My blade has been still for too long.
意料之外的礼物……不过，谢谢。
I did not expect this gift... I will remember it.
So many weak and droll people in here...
日常锻炼还是需要保持
A daily regimen is still needed.
No, alcohol will affect my judgment.
都铎执掌的军队纪律严明，军队规章近乎严苛，却从未有人叛逃。
Under General Thador's stern hand, the army marched with unrelenting discipline, bound by laws most severe, yet never did a warrior forsake his oath.
在长老会议上，大部分时间都是奎茵和沙利叶在针锋相对，都铎从不参与二人的战局。
During the council meetings, most of the time it was High Priestess Velara and Prince Ravion going at each other's throats. General Thador, however, never got involved in their battle of words.
都铎认为，不是他选择了女王，而是他的信条不允许自己站在女王的对立面。
Thador himself never believed he had chosen to follow the Queen willingly. No, his principles simply wouldn't let him stand against her.
孩子们经常在睡前唱诵《了不起的长老》——一首讲述三长老故事的童谣。唱到都铎的部分时，大部分孩子已经睡着。
The children of Sal'Thorin often sang "The Three On High", a nursery rhyme about the Three Exarchs, before bed. By the time they get to Thador's verse, most are already fast asleep.
“都铎将军几乎不需要睡眠！我亲眼看见他站在那里一天一夜纹丝未动！像一座山一样。”——都铎手下士兵的闲聊。
"General Thador barely sleeps! I swear, I saw him stand there for a full day and night without moving... like a damn mountain!"—A palace guard once said deep in his cups
每次任务结束后，都铎的铠甲上总会残留淡淡的硫磺气息。
After every mission, there was always a faint whiff of sulfur clinging to Thador's armor.
“都铎将军是军队的支柱！年长的贵族尊敬他，年轻的战士畏惧他。非要说的话，沙利叶殿下是个例外……”——王城卫兵的议论
"General Thador is the backbone of the army! The old nobles respect him, the young recruits fear him... Prince Ravion seems to be the only exception."—City guard
都铎有着异乎寻常的忍耐力，这体现在他对日复一日枯燥工作的平静上。
There is an uncanny steadfastness in Thador, a quiet defiance against monotony, as he faces each tedious day with unbroken composure.
从未有人听见过都铎说谎，甚至在面对自己的背叛时，他也选择了沉默。
No whisper of deceit had ever passed Thador's lips, not even in the wake of his own betrayal. His silence spoke where words would not.
“愚昧没什么不好。相反，它是能更好施展仁慈的方式。”——都铎
"Ignorance isn't a flaw. It's an opportunity for mercy."—General Thador
在地底守卫不可告人的秘密……将军，这就是你对萨洛克兰的守护方式？
Guarding the secrets underground... General, is that your way of protecting Sal'thorin?
熔岩只应在地底涌动，不应被曝露于目光之下。
Lava should remain flowing beneath the ground, not exposed to the light.
最近肩膀和脖颈的肌肉总是紧绷绷的。
My shoulder and neck muscles have been feeling a bit tight lately.
如今的丛林，仍然是三贤者管理吗？
Is the Dark Forest still overseen by the Three Sages?
So many weak and droll people in here...
No, alcohol will affect my judgment.
这地方可真不错，当然了，跟死气沉沉的图书馆相比，哪里都好。
This place is nice. Honestly, anywhere beats that dead-as-a-doornail library.
